svg.title: Contribution distribution, trailing 365 days
svg.desc: Daily contribution distribution over the trailing 365 days, Asia/Kuala Lumpur time. 1,161 contributions in total, active on 162 of 366 days (44.3%). The busiest single day was 91 contributions on 2026-08-18. Median 3 contributions per active day, longest quiet stretch 44 days. Composition: 1,047 commits, 70 pull requests, 2 issues, 1 private.
